crossRefs.note: The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they divided the land.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: The children of Israel did as Yahweh commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
translations.bsb: So the Israelites did as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they divided the land.
translations.kjv: As the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did, and they divided the land.
translations.asv: As Jehovah commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did; and they divided the land.
